items.title: Three reasons stocks are moving higher after the midterms
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi runs down three reasons why stocks are responding well to the midterm election results.

items.title: Why Elon Musk will keep funding Grok, no matter the cost
items.summary: In the Loop Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen sets the table for why he believes Elon Musk is willing to keep pouring money into his AI project, Grok, no matter the cost. Ahamadeen explains why he believes personal AI assistants will become the “most important and valuable layer” for how people interact with the broader digital world.

items.title: Oracle Continues to Crash Lower and Lower But Two Bullish Desks Agree That Its Price WIll More Than Triple
items.summary: Oracle has shed half its value in a year while racking up billions in negative free cash flow, yet two Wall Street desks just slapped $400 price targets on a stock trading at $126. Something has to give.

items.title: Constellation Energy Sinks 8%, Vistra Down 14% as Democrats’ Midterm Sweep Hits AI Power Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysConstellation Energy fell 8% this morning after Democrats won Congress, in a selloff that also hit Vistra, GE Vernova and CoreWeave. Its signed deals with Alphabet’s Google and Amazon still stand, so the risk is in future contracts.

items.title: Amazon Soars 7% as Tech Shrugs Off Data Center Bans: “Can Buy Its Way Into New Towns”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAmazon jumped 7% today and Microsoft rallied with it, after 10 Ohio towns banned large data centers. Amazon, Microsoft and Alphabet can afford to build elsewhere, so local bans won’t slow their AI spending.
